use_case_name: Transfer a Winning Order to Another Customer

claims.content: Customer

A winning customer's order is cancelled due to non-payment (specifically for PayPal or Amazon Payments users who fail to pay within 7 days), triggering an automated offer to the second-place finisher.

trigger.raw_text: A winning customer's order is cancelled due to non-payment (specifically for PayPal or Amazon Payments users who fail to pay within 7 days), triggering an automated offer to the second-place finisher.

claims.content: When orders are cancelled due to non-payment, an automated email is triggered and sent to the second-place finisher (if one exists), offering to sell the item at their last bid price.
The email gives the recipient three options: Credit Card Option, PayPal or Amazon Payments Option, or Decline Option.
If the Credit Card Option is chosen, the user clicks 'I accept, pay with my On File credit card', triggering an automated process to generate an order and ship the item with no further action needed.

If the PayPal or Amazon Payments Option is chosen, the user clicks 'Pay with PayPal or Amazon Payments', which generates the order and loads the Sign-In page; after signing in, the user is taken to the Returning Winners Payments Page to pay for the order.
If the Decline Option is chosen by clicking 'No Thanks', the item is released from hold status back into auction available inventory.
If the customer does not respond to the 2nd-Chance email within 72 hours, the item is returned to auction available inventory and rescheduled for a future auction.
The 2nd-Chance email will not be sent if the 2nd-place finisher's bid is below the item's unit cost.

The 2nd-Chance email will not be sent to recipients who have two accounts and are essentially bidding against themselves; matches on Customer Name, Phone Number, Email Address, Member ID, or Billing/Shipping Addresses prevent the email from being sent.
If the Credit Card Option is chosen, an order is generated and the item is shipped automatically with no further action needed by the customer.
If the PayPal or Amazon Payments Option is chosen, an order is generated and the user is directed to the Sign-In page and then to the Returning Winners Payments Page to complete payment.
If the Decline Option is chosen, the item is released from hold status back into auction available inventory.
If the customer does not respond to the 2nd-Chance email within 72 hours, the item is returned to auction available inventory and rescheduled for a future auction.
